Subject: GCP private offer — consumption tiers and invoicing cadence

Hi Jonas,

Thanks again for the demo last week — DataWave is excited to move toward a private offer on GCP. Procurement asked me to share our expected consumption profile so they can approve the PO and invoicing cadence. I attached an initial consumption worksheet (DataWave_Consumption_Request.xlsx) with quarterly targets and a note about when credits need to hit the invoices.

High level: we expect a heavy ramp in Q4 (training/ingestion) and steady state usage in 2027. Procurement would prefer quarterly drawdown tied to invoicing rather than monthly. Can Redwood support a quarterly draw schedule on the private offer? If yes, we'd like a short call early next week to lock the schedule and SOW.

CCing Sasha from our procurement team.

Thanks,
Kyle Turner
Head of Cloud Partnerships
DataWave Analytics

Kyle — really appreciate the worksheet and visibility. Yes, Redwood supports quarterly drawdown on GCP private offers; we typically surface a draw schedule in the SOW and can align billing to the quarter so procurement sees the credit allocation per invoice.

I'm going to loop in our billing lead, Marissa Cole, and our GCP marketplace lead, Karthik Iyer, to make sure the proposed numbers will map to the private offer configuration and invoicing workflow. Can you confirm the target start date for the private offer (you mentioned early Sept) and whether DataWave needs invoice-level detail for token-by-token usage or just an aggregated committed drawdown line item?

If it helps, propose 30 minutes on Tuesday (Aug 11) 10:00–10:30 PT and we'll send a calendar invite.

Best,

Kyle / Sasha — thanks for the patience. After internal review we've put together a proposed quarterly drawdown schedule that maps to DataWave's worksheet and the GCP private offer constraints. High level proposal (attached):

- Total committed value: $1,200,000 (12-month term)
- Q3 ramp (partial quarter): $150,000
- Q4 heavy ramp: $450,000
- Q1 2027: $300,000
- Q2 2027: $300,000

We will reflect the above as a single committed line item in the private offer so procurement receives a quarterly invoice with the committed credit applied. Token-level telemetry will still be available in the Redwood Console for reconciliation, but the invoice will show an aggregated committed draw amount per quarter. Rollover policy: unused committed credits do not roll forward; we can discuss limited carry-forward in the SOW if needed.

Action items:
- Attached: Redwood_GCP_PrivateOffer_SOW_v3.pdf (SOW with billing cadence language) and consumption_schedule_proposed.xlsx (detailed mapping).
- I've created HubSpot record HS-123456 and linked the DocuSign envelope for the SOW: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/record/HS-123456 and https://www.docusign.com/sign?transaction=0a1b2c3d4e
- If that looks good, sign the SOW and we'll provision the private offer in GCP (link to draft offer will be shared once provisioning is complete).

Please confirm by EOD Thursday (Aug 14) and we'll queue the private offer provisioning. If you want a quick clarifying call, Marissa and Karthik are on standby to join.
